options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --kind KIND        decision|constraint|convention|context|format|finding|att
                     empt
  --summary SUMMARY
  --author AUTHOR
  --tags TAGS        comma-separated
  --body BODY
  --supersedes OLD   mark OLD superseded by this note in the same write
  --batch FILE       write the notes in a JSON array (FILE, or - for stdin),
                     all or none; each has id, kind, summary, body, and
                     optionally author, tags, supersedes
